batting.name: J Arunkumar
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b S Sreesanth

batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b R Vinay Kumar

balls.text: lucky escape for Bangalore! Kumble backs away and fails to club a full toss, Kaul lets that one slip past him and conceded four byes

pushes a yorker down to long-on, they take a chance with Chawla's throw at long-on and Boucher is struggling to make his ground, Kaul whips off the bails and the third umpire takes his time on that, Boucher is just centimeters short of his ground
much better.... Boucher walks across his stumps and the premeditated paddle comes off well, he scoops a low full toss well out of reach of short fine leg
another yorker by Pathan and Boucher fails to slam it past the bowler, Pathan nearly flings the ball back at the stumps
makes room and digs out a fullish delivery towards point, that's just another single
that's a low full toss from Pathan, it swings in sharply and Boucher chops it down to extra cover
he sees him make room but sprays it spectacularly wide outside the offstump
swing and a miss, Zaheer makes room but fails to make contact, that ends a great spell by VRV
that was a fast screeching yorker, that was excellent cricket all round as the batsman gets his bat down on time to keep it out
makes room and swings and misses, Kaul has a shy at the stumps but they pick up a single after the ball deflects off the stump
full, pushed to midwicket, he has a shy at the stumps but there's a fielder backing the throw

he tries to get too cheeky by shuffling across his stumps before the bowler delivers, he exposes all stumps, the ball lands on a good length and flattens the offstump as Vinay Kumar misses the paddle stroke
fires that on a yorker length and it comes on fast too, he makes room and pushes it down the ground to long-off
Sreesanth gets away a full toss, it's directed at the body but Boucher only places it straight to deep square leg
bangs it in short this time, he walks down the track early but only manages to mistime it to long-on, the runs aren't coming I'm afraid
gets that reverse swing working and lands that on the blockhole in line of offstump, he somehow squeezes it out to mid-off
full and swinging in on the pads, he gets a thin inside edge and the ball trickles to mid-off, they take a quick single while Sreesanth gets busy with the appeal
loses his line and misdirects it down the legside, he fails to make contact on the nudge
he foxes him completely with a slower ball, Sreesanth bowls the slow legcutter, Praveen makes room and advances down the track, the ball goes through straight and hits the top of offstump
starts off with a lovely reverse swinging yorker, he makes plenty of room to carve it through the offside but fails to make proper contact
VRV ends an excellent over with another yorker, he makes room and digs it out to cover, only five off that over
Praveen makes room but fails to put away a full toss, he checks his stroke and instead angles it down to sweeper cover
jams that on the blockhole again and Boucher can only manage a single to mid-off
fires it on the blockhole and keeps Boucher quiet as he fails to squeeze it out, good stuff from VRV
makes room to slice that through the off side, he digs out the yorker to cover
bangs it in short and tests him out with a lifter, he hops and fends it off to the offside
action replay! Hopes errs again by overpitching outside off and Boucher sends it crashing past extra cover who gives up trying to stop it
that was too full outside off, Boucher made room and creamed it past extra cover
Hopes bowls the offcutter and Boucher reads it early, he gets down and slogs that high over deep midwicket, that was all power
he rocks back and cuts hard, Marsh does really well at backward point to fling himself to his right and cut it off
tucks him up with the lifter, he gets on his knee and fends it off to the on side
full on the stumps, he creams this to long-on to get off strike
Pathan fires in the quicker one on the pads, Dravid tries to whip it across the line but gets beaten for pace, the ball deflects off his pads and hits the offstump
bowls the slower one and lands it fractionally short, he steps down the track and mistimes it to long-on
fullish on the pads, he pushes it down towards long-on, another single...
fires that on the blockhole and he squeezes it out to point
opens the face of the bat late and steers it towards point, Marsh's throw at the striker's end is wide
steps down the track and checks his stroke, he slams it down to extra cover
slides on the pads and Dravid times it very crisply past midwicket, the ball was really traveling quickly and Sreesanth's dive wasn't enough to intercept it
this one too cuts back in sharply and he chops it down in front of cover and sets off fast
he goes for the pull way too early and the ball gets caught between his legs
gives him a bit of width outside off and he slams it hard straight to point
this one nips back in sharply and cramps him for room, he cuts it to point
plenty of confusion with the running, he tucks it to the offside and sends him back, the throw is wide and they nearly take the overthrow
slides on the pads, he gets on his knee and sweeps to fine leg
steps down the track and whips it from outside off and places it to square leg and sets off
stays back at the crease, the ball straightens and he cuts it wide of point
stays back at the crease, waits for the turn and slams it past extra cover
gets on his knee and sweeps to fine leg
drags that from outside the offstump and mows it away wide of midwicket
stays back and punches this one to long-off
loops in around the offstump, he opens the face of the bat and plays it to short third man
meets the ball on the pads outside the line of legstump, the ball rolls to the on side
pushes it a little flatter on the pads, he stays back and whips it to deep square
gets the ball to turn a little, he stays back and works it to square leg
stays back and the ball keeps low, he covers the line and plays a backfoot punch to long-on
slides it around the legstump and Boucher fails to make contact with the sweep
slightly short and wide outside off, he stays back and punches to deep point
slides on the pads, he tucks it away wide of midwicket
pitches the googly around the offstump, he stays at the crease and steers it to gully
full outside off, he drives to long-off

outstanding return catch! Chawla gives it air on middle, White backs away a little and tries to slog that over deep midwicket, he fails to read the length and hence gets a thick top edge which sails towards midwicket, Chawla runs backwards and hangs onto it, he tumbles after taking it
flighted on middle and leg, he gets down and sweeps behind square on the on side
gets on his knee and sweeps to fine leg
fires in the quicker one which comes back in sharply, Dravid makes room, controls the cut and places it to the deep backward point boundary
rocks back waits for the turn and cuts it towards gully
fullish outside off, he square drives it to sweeper cover
slides on the pads, he sweeps this time behind square on the on side
slides on the pads, he fails to put it away
walks across his stumps and pushes it firmly down to Luke Pomersbach at long-off
times it a little too well towards mid-off and Dravid wisely turns down the single
bowls it full on middle and he whips it down towards midwicket
steers it down to third man and takes the first run quickly, Dravis sets off for the second run but White wisely sends him back
pushes it firmly in front of mid-off and sets off fast, the throw is just a little wide at the non striker's end
slides towards the pads this time and he tucks it through the line wide of midwicket, Chawla scampers across to intercept it
full and wide outside off, he square drives it to sweeper cover
gets quickly down on his knee and pierces the gap behind square on the offside
flighted on  middle and leg, he gets forward and tucks it to midwicket
lunges forward to a full delivery and pushes it down to long-off
gets on his knee early and paddles it down to fine leg
leans forward and chips a low full toss down to midwicket
covers the line and pushes a full delivery firmly down to long-on, that was off the meat of the bat
holds the length back outside off, he opens the face of the bat and steers it towards point
fires that on the blockhole outside off and he squeezes it out hard wide of backward point and down to third man
Dravid gets forward and taps it in front of cover with soft hands and gets off the blocks immediately
that was a neat drive but straight to extra cover
starts off with a good length ball which comes back in and tucks him up, he gets behind the line and defends to the on side
ends the over with a sharp googly, he stays back and punches it back to the bowler
he gets well forward and defends it off the pads outside the line of offstump, Chawla appeals
he goes to over the wicket this time, lands it on off stump and Dravid tucks it on the front foot to the on side

Chawla strikes back! The ball dips in on off and middle and shoots through a little low, Kohli goes back to the wrong delivery and the ball skids through and hits the offstump, Chawla gets on his knee and punches the air
he pushes this one a little quicker but errs in his line again as he strays on the pads and Kohli sweeps it just wide of short fine leg
this one dips in on the pads and that was in the slot for Kohli got on his knee quickly and swept it wide of short fine leg
bowls from round the wicket, he strays way too far outside leg and the ball beats Kaul and just about everyone

Misbah why do these things always happen to you?? Sreesanth gets this one to nip back in sharply, Misbah goes back and across a little too far and trods onto his stumps before pushing it to the offside, how unlucky, initially nobody noticed what had happened and then....

shot of the day so far! That was the 1000th four of the IPL. Misbah takes the risk of backing away and exposing all his stumps, Sreesanth lands it on middle on a full length and Misbah plays superb square drive, his head and position were excellent
and for the umpteenth time today an edge falls short behind the wicket, he plays it with very soft hands and Jayawardene fumbles as it comes onto him on the first bounce
excellent comeback by Sreesanth as he lands it on the seam outside off and just gets a hint of away movement, it beats Kohli on the forward prod
holds the length back a little bit and he chops it down towards cover
stand and deliver! Sreesanth pitches it up on off and middle and he lofts it cleanly through the line, off the meat of the bat and just clears long-off
pitches outside the offstump, he opens the face of the bat and chops it down hard to third man
takes a few paces down the track for a wild swish over the on side but he gets a thick outside edge which travels to Chawla at third man
fullish outside the offstump, he leans forward and drives to mid-off
the slower one from Pathan and this induces an edge but it fails to carry through to the keeper
this time Pathan drives it wide outside off and Kohli plays a conventional cover drive, gets to the pitch of the ball and creams it wide of extra cover
that was imperious! The delivery was just fractionally short on middle and leg but Kohli was alert enough to swivel early and play a short arm pull past midwicket and mid-on
Sreesanth dishes out another short one but directs it down the leg side, he swivels and the ball appears to lob off the glove, there was enough power to carry that through to fine leg
he bangs it in short and Misbah pulls, he didn't appear to be in full control of the shot but nevertheless it was enough to clear midwicket
similar line and length, this time he angles his bat and steers it towards third man
Sreesanth beats him with a jaffa, that moves away rather late and just beats the outside edge, the ball dips low before reaching Kaul
Misbah gets off the mark with a square cut which he keeps down and glides it along the turf to third man

they had it coming.... Sreesanth pitches it around the offstump and the extra bit of bounce squares up Arunkumar who attempts a square cut, the edge flies to Jayawardene who takes the catch above his waist, there was quite a bit swishing outside off before this and this dismissal was inevitable
this time Pathan bowls the one that goes away from the right hander and nearly gets his man as he fishes outside the offstump, no runs off the bat in the over, good one by Pathan
shuffles across to push that through the gap on the on side but midwicket intercepts it, the on side is quite packed for him
takes a couple of paces down the track and checks his stroke at the last minute, the ball goes on the first bounce to slip
walks across his stumps early to cover the inward movement and he tucks it down to square leg
lands it on a good length just outside off and gets it to come back in, he taps it down towards point
gets it to curve in towards the pads and he nudges it very close to his pads, prompting an appeal, that was off the bat
pitches it in line of offstump and the ball holds its line, he gets behind it and angles it down towards point
false shot by Kohli as he stretches out to slash at one outside off, Sreesanth gets quite a bit of away movement
pitches this one on middle and leg and Kohli shuffles across and tucks it wide of fine leg for a couple
he flays at a wide offering outside off and the ball seams away after pitching
Sreesanth lands it on a length on the corridor outside off and the ball holds its line, he shoulders arms
action straightaway, Sreesanth bowls it full and wide and he goes for an expansive drive, the ball flies off the toe edge of the bat and fails to carry to Pomersbach at second slip
that's it! Praveen bowls another slower one, he gently steers it in front of cover and takes the single
that's a dot ball, a rarity here, Praveen bowls the slow yorker and he can't dig it out
slides on the pads again and he whips it through the line to deep midwicket
full on the pads, he pushes this to long-on
he bludgeons a low full toss and nearly cleans up Zaheer in the process, he just manages to evade it
tries to nudge it down to fine leg, the ball clips his pads and they pick up a legbye
bangs it in short and he plays a short arm pull, he bludgeons it past square leg, he wants to finish this NOW

Marsh now edges this one down towards third man, the fielder at third man slides and initially cuts it off, the ball deflects off his palm and he gathers himself and attempts to pull it back again, he does and throws it back, replays showed the ball just touching the rope on the second attempt
stand and deliver! Zaheer pitches it up outside off and Marsh plays the most elegant of straight drives, the ball hits the meat of the bat and beats mid-off
Zaheer returns for a new spell, he takes a few paces down the track, fails to cover the length of the ball and hence mistimes it to the on side
bowls the conventional legbreak, he slides on the pads and he tucks it to mid-on
Kumble bowls a seam-up delivery, the ball comes on straight and Marsh plays the most delicate of late cuts as he glides it to third man
tries to glance it late but he ends up chopping it down to the offside
makes room and slashes it wide of point
shot! He bowls the googly but he takes a few paces down the track, smothers the turn and carts it high over deep square leg
hits a fullish length outside off, he makes room and places it wide of point
sprays that a little too wide outside off, he decides not to chase it
fullish on the pads, he tucks it off his pads and places it wide of square leg
goes for an across the line swipe but he mistimes it to square leg
fullish outside off, he makes room and pushes it to long-off
makes room, steps down and bangs this down to long-off
that was short again and the ball comes on so slowly that he has the time to drag it from outside off and play a short-arm pull past midwicket
lands it short of a length outside off, he punches to long-off
flighted on the pads, he gets across and whips it behind square on the on side
makes room again, sees the ball pitching outside off and he slices it down to third man
makes a bit of room and slices it wide of point to bring up the 100
flat! Kumble flights it outside off, he charges down the track and carts this hard and flat over long-off
steps forward and pushes this one towards mid-off
flighted outside off, he gets forward and taps it towards short third man
bangs this on short of a length and he pulls and finds the fielder at deep square leg
better delivery, this one kicks up off a good length and he taps it softly in front of cover and brings up his fifty
he bowls the slower ball but slides down the legside
he rubs it in further, Steyn bowls the inswinger and lands it on the blockhole outside off, he stretches out and gets a thick outside edge which beats the keeper
shot! That was to short again and Marsh plays a flat-batted biff over mid-off, he's seeing it like a football here
take that! Steyn comes round the wicket and thuds it in too short, Marsh slashes on the up and the ball shoots over backward point like a bullet
Steyn returns for a second spell, he pitches it a little too wide, he slashes past cover and Misbah nearly intercepts it, unfortunately the ball deflects off his hand and trickles to the rope
driven back to the bowler
pitched on off, stays straight and low to beat the batsman
pushed to leg side
pitched on leg, Marsh steps out and away and plays to off side
pitched on leg and an outside edge from the bat takes it to third-man boundary
driven to mid-on
pitched on middle and Marsh times and places his cut to perfection - the fielder at backward point couldn't get to it as it raced to the boundary
cut to point
pitched on leg and Marsh tried to flick it but edges the ball and it falls by the pitch. he thinks of taking a single but changes his mind as Vinay runs towards him
driven to cover
glided to third man and they ran hard for those runs
pitched just outside leg and brushes the pad before slipping between bat and pad and through the keepers legs for four byes
defended to point
nice one. Marsh steps out of the crease and picks up the ball from off stump to a six over long-off
swept to fine leg
pitched on leg, flicked to midwicket
pitched on middle and leg, cut to point
driven to cover
defended to cover
cut to third man

Vinaykumar gets them the crucial wicket, pitched on off and Hopes tries to replicate his earlier six to long-off, but it doesn't have the legs and Dale Steyn runs in from deep extra cover to take a diving catch
pitched on off, driven to cover
defended back to the bowler
overpitched, Hopes stays on the crease and picks it cleanly to long-off
cut to third man
pitched on off and Hopes goes for an almighty pull, swivelling around completely, ball goes to midwicket
dropped this time its Hopes, pitched on off and the batsman drives it back to bowler but Zaheer can't hold on to it as he dives in his follow-through
full on the off and driven to point
beaten by the slower ball, Marsh looks to cut and ball slips under his bat to the keeper
dropped over-pitched but moving in and Marsh drives it on the up to mid-off where Chipli grasses it
flicked to leg side
pitched on  off, Hopes plays across the line and pulls it with ease over midwicket. He just twisted his upper body for that one
pitched on off, Hopes tries to cut but gets an edge instead and the ball stays on the crease
pitched on middle, worked away to mid-on
opens the face of the bat and angles it down to third man
Hopes punches it crisply towards backward point but Kohli intercepts it and cuts off a couple
cracker! Zaheer bangs it in short but it gets a little predictable, Hopes anticipates it early, gets on top of the bounce and clubs it cleanly over deep midwicket
short of a length, he swivels and the ball appears to brush his glove before reaching Boucher on the first bounce
another super delivery, bangs it on middle and holds its line, Hopes really has no room to work with and ends up pushing it to mid-off
gets it to go straight on the pads, he whips it across the line but finds square leg
good finish to the over as he cramps him for room, Marsh nearly chops it back onto his stumps, Boucher leaps and collects the ball
he sees the full delivery and chips it quite softly towards mid-on, Kumble slides to his left and intercepts it one handed
he waits for the inward movement, closes the face of the bat and works it wide of mid-on
gets a bit of late away swing, that;s his stock delivery, he leans forward and taps it softly to mid-off and sets off
cramps him for room outside off but he adjusts well by getting his bat down on an angle and steering it to third man
Praveen slides that wide outside off and gets away with it as Marsh chops it down to extra cover
Marsh spoils a potential maiden as he opens the face of the bat and deftly angles it wide of point
this is restrictive stuff from Zaheer as he gets one to nip back in and tuck him up, he chops it down to point
hits a good length outside off and he opens the face of the bat and angles it down to point
lovely delivery! he fires that at good pace and gets it to dart back in sharply, Marsh does well to let that go
angles towards the pads and he misses out a scoring opportunity as he gets a thin edge onto his pads
pitches outside off and holds its line, Marsh chooses to let it go, we don't see that very often in Twenty20
slides on the pads and he whips it wide of midwicket for a couple, that ends an expensive first over
full and wide outside off, he shapes to loft over cover but he plays it off the toe edge of the bat and the ball lands in the middle of nowhere
fires that on middle and leg, he gets his bat down quickly and nudges it wide of fine leg
the late inward movement slides on the pads and he whips it away wide of square leg
hits a good length outside off and gets to shape back in before reaching the keeper
edged! Steyn pitches it outside off and gets it to move away, the outside edge just beats slip on the bounce and Zaheer slides really well at third man to save three runs
poor delivery to start off, he slides wide down the legside and Boucher fumbles as well
